name: livro-caixa
description: App de celular para controlar o financeiro de uma família

scripts.test:rules: firebase -c firebase/firebase.test.json emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-livro-caixa "node --test --test-concurrency=1 firebase/rules-tests/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:migrations: firebase -c firebase/firebase.test.json emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-livro-caixa "node --test --test-concurrency=1 firebase/migrations/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:contract: firebase -c firebase/firebase.test.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-livro-caixa "pnpm mobile test:contract"
scripts.verify: pnpm docusaurus test && pnpm docusaurus build
